Messages.Author: Desso Alastor
Messages.Body:
Brothers, look that cool deck appeared yesterday in SP tournament, basically a deck with prox cards, this list came second at the final table of the tournament, congratulations idea Alan Winther, got a utility for Gramle (letter of 0,05cents)
.
I have no doubt that trimming borders this deck will revolutionize the idea of decks practically prox cards.

Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Wow, nasty.
I like the Gangrel Revel in this deck. Blocking Valkyries with strength will make some Walldecks thinking. Too bad it can be destroyed with a d-action.
This deck is a bit like The Black Plaque, which maybe has one or two nice tricks more. OTOH there are the many Gehennas. Fun for the player, not so much for the others.

I like it.

Edit: What about Eco Terrorists and a Secure Haven for Brunhilde for saving her from the danger of torporization. And you need an Aranthebes for contesting.

Baron of Frankfurt
